|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/tydirium.html</ref>

Those sneaky Rebels have gone and got themselves another spy plane! To assist the ever popular [[Tantive IV]], the Tydiriumprovides a similar ability in letting you deploy it and characters aboard without presence or Force icons. All that for only 2 Force! The only drawback is that there is no permanent pilot, so you must have a character to put aboard before you can deploy it to space.

Combo: = This all deploys for only 8 Force, gets you power 5, 2 battle destinies and a whole lotta forfeit.
